name: weapon
description: Player-initiated combat: attack target resolution, the player swing (kill handling, corpse+loot creation, enemy.killed/enemy.attacked), sleep-kills, combat stances (fight), the pow/dodge moves, and the contested-flee move gate. Also owns AMMUNITION — any weapon tagged ammo_capacity spends a round per swing and is refilled by RELOAD from a matching ammo_load item. Registers the ATTACK Action and the gameLoop auto-attack provider.
